correctness.rationale: The two-sided stationary Poisson construction yields a Laplace initial velocity with rate sqrt(r/D). Conditional on every future reset partition, the increment decomposes into initial velocity times first interval plus an independent Gaussian with variance (2D/3) times the sum of cubes of interval lengths. The uniform tail domination and fixed-partition limits establish the positive-tail amplitude and no-reset posterior. The exact mgf domain and singular boundary coefficient follow by conditional Laplace transforms and dominated convergence. Covariance integration independently yields the variance formula. All quantifiers require fixed positive r,D,T; no finite computation is treated as a proof of an infinite limit. Actual packaged numerical checker reports 158 assertions.

originality.rationale: The quantitatively sharp fixed-horizon stationary-initial-velocity tail, its exact amplitude and its extreme-event no-future-reset posterior are distinct from previous long-time diffusion and Gaussian-area deviations. The accessible 2020 Singh primary manuscript treats resetting of both coordinates or position alone, not resetting of velocity alone, as shown in its model equations (3)-(4) and conclusions. Olsen–Löwen 2024 studies the relevant velocity-reset model and its propagator/moments but only abstract and indexing material were accessible during this review; its uninspected full text is the principal priority risk. Smith–Majumdar 2022 studies a different initial ensemble and joint long-time/large-deviation scaling rather than fixed positive T then x→∞. Targeted online literature and semantic database comparisons gave no positive coverage; this is a best-knowledge priority assessment, not a uniqueness proof.
residual_risks: Full text of the most directly relevant Olsen–Löwen (2024) paper was not available during this review, so an unrecognized equivalent fixed-horizon tail result there cannot be excluded.
Full text of Smith–Majumdar (2022) was not examined; its broad Gaussian-area framework may encode related conclusions in a different initialization.
No claim of exhaustive coverage of unpublished work, future publications or all broader renewal-process theorems.

value.rationale: In velocity-only resetting, low-order transport data indicate ordinary long-time diffusion, but the fixed-horizon rare displacement tail is exponential and generated almost entirely by histories with no reset inside the window. The exact amplitude, exponential-moment threshold and history posterior reveal a sharp experimentally meaningful boundary between stationary initialization and freshly reset initialization; these are not mere parameter substitutions or known-table recomputations. The precise coefficient and reset-history inference are motivated by the physical mechanism; no finite-sample diagnostic guarantee is claimed.
